items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Another brother named Effie, Effie Robertson. He was the bass player.

ctx.x: No, he was the cyclophon player. Another brother named Effie, Effie Robertson. He was the bass player. Effie? Effie. Effie. My oldest brother played trombone. And his name? His name Sparks. Sparks. Yeah.
When did the saxophone come out for your brother to play?
